knowledge:
- key_parameters: bamTreatment=A list of BAM files or GAlignments representing the treatment condition ;; bamControl=A list of BAM files or GAlignments representing the control condition ;; gtf=A path to a GTF file or a GRanges object containing 3'UTR coordinates with "gene_id" ending in "_PRE" or "_POST" ;; stranded=A logical parameter in countPrePost (e.g., TRUE/FALSE) indicating whether the RNA-seq protocol was strand-aware ;; fpkmCutoff=The expression threshold used in pvalueFilter to filter out lowly expressed genes ;; pvalCutoff=The significance threshold used in pvalueFilter to filter results based on Fisher's exact test p-values
- alternatives: roarWrapper or roarWrapper_chrBychr=Wrapper scripts that automate the analysis steps, with roarWrapper_chrBychr recommended for large datasets to process chromosome-by-chromosome and save memory ;; RoarDatasetMultipleAPA=A class designed for analyzing genes with multiple alternative polyadenylation sites ;; computePairedPvals=An alternative to computePvals used when a paired experimental design is present to combine p-values using Fisher's method
- when_to_use: Use this package when you want to detect preferential usage of shorter or longer transcript isoforms via alternative polyadenylation (APA) using RNA-seq alignment data (BAM files) from two biological conditions and a PRE/POST annotated GTF file.
- pitfalls: High memory usage can occur with large BAM files; use roarWrapper_chrBychr to process chromosome-by-chromosome to avoid out-of-memory errors ;; FPKM values calculated chromosome-by-chromosome will differ from whole-genome calculations; use countResults to extract raw counts and compute FPKM manually if needed ;; Overlapping 3'UTRs can lead to discarded reads in single APA analyses, potentially biasing results; consider filtering annotations beforehand ;; The GTF file must strictly contain exactly one "_PRE" and one "_POST" entry per gene ID, and missing transcript lengths will default to genomic lengths, which can be inaccurate if introns are present.

workflows.name: standard_apa_analysis
workflows.intent: Identify differential alternative polyadenylation (APA) usage between two biological conditions using RNA-seq BAM files and a PRE/POST annotated GTF file.
input: bamTreatment (RNA-seq BAM files for the treatment condition)
bamControl (RNA-seq BAM files for the control condition)
gtf (GTF file containing PRE/POST annotations for 3'UTRs)
workflows.stages: 1. Load libraries and initialize the RoarDataset object ;; 2. Count reads overlapping PRE and POST portions ;; 3. Compute the ratio of prevalence (m/M) and roar values ;; 4. Compute p-values using Fisher's exact test ;; 5. Extract and filter results
workflows.code:
library(roar)
library(rtracklayer)
library(RNAseqData.HNRNPC.bam.chr14)
gtf <- system.file("examples", "apa.gtf", package="roar")
# HNRNPC ko data
bamTreatment <- RNAseqData.HNRNPC.bam.chr14_BAMFILES[seq(5,8)]
# control (HeLa wt)
bamControl <- RNAseqData.HNRNPC.bam.chr14_BAMFILES[seq(1,3)]
rds <- RoarDatasetFromFiles(bamTreatment, bamControl, gtf)
rds <- countPrePost(rds, FALSE)
rds <- computeRoars(rds)
rds <- computePvals(rds)
results <- totalResults(rds)
results_filtered <- pvalueFilter(rds, fpkmCutoff=-Inf, 
                                 pvalCutoff=0.05)
nrow(results_filtered[results_filtered$nUnderCutoff==12,])
